newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends steady in a quiet session.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends steady in a quiet session.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed mostly steady at 43.7485/7495 to the dollar in a quiet session of interbank market on Sunday, dealers said.
The local unit was quoted stronger at 43.7450/7490 per dollar but lost the ground later on easing of the call rates.
Dealers said the session was quiet with very few deals in foreign currency mostly because of the weekend closure of international markets.
The call money was traded at 7.5 to 9.5 percent, down from previous close at 11-14 percent.
